delivery.slide_count_policy: Use exactly 18 slides unless an explicit_user_override requests another count, a range, or no fixed count. Use 20-26 for a full formal academic talk.

color_contract.current_color_system: preserve metadata and derive one restrained accent
color_contract.poster_palette: do not spread poster surface roles across the deck

prefer: serif main hierarchy with sans-serif small labels
flat editorial composition with varied evidence-led layouts
source figures and source tables with editable visual explanation
reject: dashboard card grids or nested panels
